study: V8 T2 endpoint, trial weighting and neural representation
evidence_scope: Offline known-participant session holdout. T2 and all development outcomes through archive rank21 informed the hypothesis; neither the development split nor T2 is untouched.

previous_evidence.interpretation: Prior numerical audits passed; all three V7 fresh T2 sessions had negative learned R2. Directional alignment near80degrees with worse-than-zero squared error motivates target/scale/coverage diagnostics, not a claim of absent neural information.

fresh_selection.selection_rule: Authenticate previous21 regular members, retain next three in archive order, no quality or outcome selection and no replacement. Rank is not chronological day. Retain shortages and short recordings.

development.scope: Existing exposed first-min(600s,duration) prefixes only; no unused tails or T3 continuation arrays.

representation_selection.objective: Equal-session mean primary R2 from daily calibration on the same purchased interval and primary mask; all candidates share score availability.

factorial_selection.objective: Equal-session mean primary R2 among the eight frozen factorial cells.

development.limits: These partitions limit additional selection reuse; they are not retrospectively pristine validation because their V2-V7 outcomes were exposed. All settings and both selected identities are published with a passed source audit before any fresh scoring. No fresh best-arm substitution.

time.meaning: Recorded observation time; gaps between acquisition blocks are not real-world elapsed time.
time.shortages: Requested cost remains120seconds; report actual available interval, eligible rows, trial counts and fallback. Incomplete recordings are retained with zero fallback or unavailable scores as appropriate.

targets.primary: Unchanged instantaneous unit(target_position-cursor_position) at second10ms sample of each within-block20ms pair; finite nonzero direction and both raw samples in one provider go interval.
targets.primary_boundary: Score common original valid-go mask after152s and62-bin block burn, but exclude every provider trial intersecting purchased[30,150). Calibration may use partial trials inside[30,150). Final right-censored scoring trial is retained; no end<=600 requirement.
targets.reference40: Position-error direction and distance at raw trial_start_index+4 (40ms at10ms resolution), only when that sample is observed and remains inside its trial.
targets.phase: 0.2 <= raw-pair endpoint age since trial onset <1.0 seconds, reference40_available and reference40_distance strictly greater than fixed provider threshold. No extra current-distance exclusion.
targets.phase_training_boundary: Require trial onset>=30s so the reference40 behavior lies inside requested labels; use only phase rows before150s.
targets.secondary: Stable reference40 unit direction, scored on far-phase rows of the common primary mask. Different target and eligible rows; never satisfies the primary gate. Report trial-averaged and bin-pooled errors separately.
targets.provider_method_limit: The fixed40ms target with0.2-1s evaluation is a prespecified diagnostic, not reproduction of provider nested-reaction-time300ms trial dSNR. Provider whole-block/session normalizers are not copied.

secondary_availability.trial_aggregation: Mean predictions and stable labels within each eligible far-phase trial, then score across equal-weight trial vectors. Report counts and independent availability; do not replace primary scores.

representation.transform: sqrt paired threshold counts; log1p paired spike-band power; causal EWMA per scale reset at acquisition blocks.
representation.normalization: Each scale uses mean and populationSD of first30 observed seconds, TXfloor0.1/SBPfloor0.01, zclip[-8,8]. Concatenate scales and divide by sqrt(number_of_scales). No labels or full-session feature moments.
representation.fit: Weighted mean squared loss plus ridge on feature coefficients, unpenalized intercept. Output projected to unit disk. Below50 selected labels gives explicit zero fallback; no replacement model.

factorial_order: representation then phase then weighting, each in listed order; retain duplicate semantic cells when source_selected equals baseline. baseline is baseline/all/uniform.
weighting: Uniform assigns equal weight per retained row. Equal_trial assigns each eligible provider go trial equal total mass, each retained row inside that trial equal mass; scale weights to mean1 (sum equals selected-row count), then divide the loss by their sum. It reduces duration dominance, not equal directional sectors. Weights depend only on purchased selected rows.

fresh_methods.primary: Single factorial method selected on T2 archive16-21 before fresh scoring. All other fresh arms are predeclared diagnostic comparisons.
fresh_methods.constant: Uniform mean of eligible purchased instantaneous targets, same baseline calibration mask; unit-disk output.
fresh_methods.trialshuffle: Use selected primary configuration. Sort eligible purchased trial chunks by first selected bin; map each recipient to next donor cyclically. For recipient lengthnr and donornd use donor indices floor(arange(nr)*nd/nr). Only purchased labels enter mapping. Fewer2trials gives zero fallback. One deterministic diagnostic, not a permutation p-value.
fresh_methods.primary_onset: Separate stable-reference40 target head, using selected representation/weighting and far_early training rows. Score on unchanged primary and stable-phase secondary, but never substitute for locked primary after fresh outcomes.

primary_error_decomposition: target mean norm and total variance
coverage: private pertrial row counts with public count-distribution aggregates only
eight-octant entropy and calibration-test total variation
TX3/TX4.5 nonzero-entry fractions and active-channel counts
instantaneous versus reference40 angular disagreement distribution
diagnostics.factorial: Paired phase and weighting differences within each matching representation cell; representation differences within each matching phase/weighting cell. Publish all cells and interaction contrasts; no postfresh arm selection.
diagnostics.task_control_limit: Constant captures target prevalence, trialshuffle checks neural/label alignment. Provider has no verified task-name/success/assist fields. Current target plus cursor would define primary target algebraically and is an oracle, not a useful neural-decoding baseline. Coverage and phase association do not identify causal task mechanisms.
diagnostics.trial_limit: Go intervals are provider trials, not guaranteed independent attempts or movements. Boundary exclusion prevents direct same-trial training/test reuse, not behavioral dependence.

evaluation.metrics: Float64 variance-weighted R2 using total SSE/SST, per-axisR2, summedMSE, angular error; null R2 if undefined or <50shared rows. All methods use identical primary score masks.
evaluation.aggregation: Equal scorable-session mean per participant, then equal participant mean. Keep every requested case and unavailable reason; costs include all selected cases.

uncertainty.T2: Paired session resampling of three requested fresh sessions; descriptive, very smallN.
uncertainty.cohort: Paired participant resampling after equal-session means; report all8 and seven nonT2 separately.

fresh_gate.name: useful_T2_primary_recovery
requirements: All3 requested T2sessions scorable on commonprimarymask
fresh_gate.limits: Only the preselected primary can pass. No alternate endpoint, best fresh cell or discarded shortage can rescue failure. Three sessions are not a powered cross-person generalization claim. Cohort effects and harms must be disclosed even if T2gate passes.

scope: Pinned source/index/raw-member lineage and exact role inventory
Reference40/sample/trial geometry and primary target parity
Purchased labels only, shared trial-disjoint masks and no future-dependent normalization
Independent weighted normal equations and full causal prediction replay for every model
Permutation donor mapping and all control artifacts
Exact two-stage exposed selection and no fresh substitution
audit.publication: Allowlisted aggregate metadata, identities, hashes and all candidate results only. Raw neural/behavior arrays, labels, prediction traces and model coefficients stay local. Pertrial rows/identities remain local; publish only trial-count distributions and effective sample sizes.

limits: No fresh participant or closed-loop/clinical efficacy claim
Raw cursor and target are historical closed-loop task variables; alternative target success is not measured intention ground truth
Phase filtering changes training information and coverage; equaltrial weighting does not isolate directioncoverage
No guarantee that lack of success proves absent neural information or biological remapping
Acquisition time and upstream feature-extraction causality remain unverified
